نستزمر (form X)
# نَسْتَزْمِرُ (nastazmiru) /nas.taz.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَزْمَرَ (istazmara)
# نَسْتَزْمِرَ (nastazmira) /nas.taz.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَزْمَرَ (istazmara)
# نَسْتَزْمِرْ (nastazmir) /nas.taz.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَزْمَرَ (istazmara)
